purpose: Machine-readable safety envelope a self-custody holder can audit before letting the Strata Signal overlay run unattended. Every bound below is sourced from committed code or committed reports; no claim of alpha is made. The strategy is a DRAWDOWN OVERLAY on a vanilla EMA trend core, not an edge.

honestyPreamble.thesis: RADICAL HONESTY. This is NOT alpha. On the held-out OOS the full pipeline LOSES money in aggregate (-0.32%); its only honest selling point is that it halves the worst-case drawdown versus buy-and-hold (58.3% -> 17.7%).
honestyPreamble.theEarner: The earner/bear-dodge is the directional EMA-30/80 trend core (ablation arm A1) sitting flat through the 2026 drawdown. The overlays modulate it at the margin only.

1_deRiskOnly.invariant: The contrarian regime overlay can ONLY de-risk (trim/flatten) or confirm an existing directional bias by scaling its EDGE. It can NEVER add leverage beyond 1x, and it can NEVER flip the directional sign (long->short or short->long).
1_deRiskOnly.mechanism: applyRegimeGate scales the EDGE (distance from the 500 flat line) by a MULTIPLICATIVE gain; the SIGN of the directional bias is preserved. Direction is set by the trend core, not the overlay.

bounds.interpretation: Gain is clamped to [GATE_MIN, GATE_MAX]. GATE_MIN=0.4 means a contradicting regime can trim edge to at most 40% of its size (toward flat) but never past zero into a flip. GATE_MAX=1.25 means a confirming regime can boost edge by at most 25%; combined with maxLeverage=1 (selectedConfig) this cannot produce >1x exposure.

source.signPreservation: applyRegimeGate (lines 156-166): gatedEdge = (directionalBias - 500) * gain; gain >= GATE_MIN > 0, so 500 + edge*gain keeps the sign of edge.

2_maxDrawdownDisqualify.invariant: HARD disqualify line: if realized maximum drawdown reaches 30%, the strategy is disqualified (mirrors the Track 1 max-drawdown disqualify threshold). The committed OOS worst case sits well inside this line.

committedOOS.headroomToDisqualify: 17.7% strategy OOS maxDD is 12.3pp inside the 30% disqualify line.

2_maxDrawdownDisqualify.stoicOOSReturnNote: The Stoic full-pipeline OOS aggregate return is a -0.32% LOSS, shown here honestly INSIDE the drawdown story — the overlay's value is risk reduction, not return.

3_universeAllowlistAndCompliance.universeNote: BTC / ETH / BNB only. Any symbol outside this allowlist is out of scope and must not be traded by the overlay.

track2Compliance.noKeys: Default unkeyed path: with no CMC_MCP_API_KEY the CMC provider is a strict {0,0} no-op (src/signal/cmcAdvisory.ts). The strategy needs no API keys to run.
track2Compliance.statement: spec-only, no keys, no on-chain writes.

4_failureModeNoFabrication.invariant: When a CoinMarketCap leg is unavailable, that field degrades to a strict {0,0} no-op contribution; it is NEVER fabricated and NEVER substituted with a stale or sample value.
4_failureModeNoFabrication.behavior: Each CMC snapshot field is a normalized {value, available} cell. An unavailable field maps to {0,0} (zero tilt, zero intensity) so a partial snapshot degrades field-by-field; an empty snapshot makes the entire CMC provider a strict {0,0} no-op on every bar.
4_failureModeNoFabrication.regimeUnknownPassThrough: Mirrors regimeGate.readRegimeGate: undefined / non-finite Fear&Greed -> { label: 'unknown', favored: 0, intensity: 0 } -> regimeGateGain returns 1.0 (pass-through). No data, no tilt.

source.regime: src/signal/regimeGate.ts readRegimeGate (lines 98-101) + regimeGateGain (line 135, returns 1.0 when favored===0)
